citations.claim: approach E yellow at step 151, start of 3s yellow
approach E still yellow at step 153, last yellow second before red at 154
first violating step: yellow lasted 3s vs required 5s, now all-red before NS

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=20 distorts later cycle timing. After emergency, EW green/yellow runs short: EW yellow spans only steps 151-153 (3s) then goes red at step 154, violating required yellow_seconds=5. Likely controller aborts/truncates yellow to recall NS direction that waited long during emergency, cutting yellow to 3s.
vision_note: Steps 151-153 show yellow on the east-west approaches while north-south stays red, with blue vehicle queues waiting. At step 154 all approaches show red, so the yellow lasts only three frames before cutting to red.
